inlines.v: ELYS'IUM, noun elyzh'um. [Latin elysium ] In ancient mythology, a place assigned to happy souls after death; a place in the lower regions, furnished with rich fields, groves, shades, streams, etc., the seat of future happiness. Hence, any delightful place.
